# Harold's Quality Auto Repair

> Independent auto repair shop in West Salem, Oregon, open since 1996. ASE Master Certified technicians, BBB Accredited (A+), NAPA AutoCare Center. Every repair carries a 1 year / 12,000 mile warranty honored at NAPA AutoCare Centers nationwide. English and Spanish.

- Address: 675 Bartell Dr NW, Salem, OR 97304 (West Salem)
- Phone / text: (503) 365-9702
- Hours: Monday–Friday 7:00 AM–5:00 PM; closed Saturday and Sunday; 24-hour key drop
- Website: https://www.haroldsautorepair.com (Spanish: https://www.haroldsautorepair.com/es)
- Facility: 8,000 sq ft, 11 bays, 9 lifts, alignment rack, in-house exhaust bending and welding

## How a visit works
Every visit includes a digital multi-point inspection. The technician photographs worn parts and texts the customer a report with measurements (brake pad mm, tire tread depth, battery voltage) rated green / yellow / red. The customer approves or declines each item from their phone; no work starts without approval. Customers get a text when the vehicle is ready with a secure pay link, and can pick up after hours. There is no courtesy shuttle or loaner car.
